ordering_constraints: Reset the control file to happy ({"mode":"happy"}) before every case unless the case specifies otherwise; each multi-step case lists per-step control contents.
Case 14 (429 -> cooldown) poisons the credential for ~1s: run it LAST among cases on the default instance, and send its step 2 immediately (<1s) after step 1.
Case 15 must not run within ~1s after case 14's step 1 (avoid cooldown interference).
Cases 1-13 and 16-18 are order-independent; recommended order is the numeric case order.
Every request re-reads the control file fresh; no mock restart needed between cases (the mock is stateless besides the control file).
record_format: Per case directory tests/fixtures/S2d3/<case-id>/: meta.yaml (anchor, date, client protocol=openai chat, upstream provider type=claude-api-key, stream flag, config fragment, dynamic fields), request.http (exact bytes sent, one per step, suffixed), downstream.md per step (status, response headers, exact body bytes - for SSE the full frame stream), upstream.jsonl (per step: what the reference emitted to the mock - method, path, headers, body; this is the primary gold for request-translation cases), mock-response.json (the scripted reply / control file contents that drove the recording).
dynamic_fields_common: downstream created (server epoch) in JSON bodies and chat.completion.chunk frames
metadata.user_id - deterministic sha256 per request content; keep bytes, mask only if they vary
